title: Best Animated Ad Agencies for Facebook and Instagram (2026)
summary: Compare seven animated ad agencies and Knowlify by the job each fits, published pricing and turnaround. Facts from each agency's own site, Oct 2026.
body_markdown:
## Who makes animated commercials and explainers you can cut for social?


### B2W


As of October 2026, B2W's[animated commercial page](https://www.b2w.tv/services/animated-commercial-video-production) says fixed-fee packages start from $2,400 for a 60-second video, with script, voiceover and sound design included. Square, vertical 9:16 and social-cut formats are included in every project, and two rounds of revisions are included at the script, storyboard and animation stages. Most projects take 4 to 6 weeks from brief to final file, or 2 to 3 weeks with a rush fee. The page describes the service as animated TV commercials and social ads for B2B brands, tech startups and cause campaigns. The[B2W homepage](https://www.b2w.tv/) lists a US office in Piscataway, New Jersey, and a production studio in Gurugram, India.


**Best for** one or a few animated commercials at a known starting price, delivered in vertical sizes. **Look elsewhere if** you need many new concepts every week for testing.


### Vidico


As of October 2026, Vidico's[animation service page](https://vidico.com/services/animation-video-production/) says it produces 2D animation, 3D animation and motion graphics end to end, including character animation, voiceover and sound design, for B2B and SaaS teams. It says monthly plans start around $5,000 a month with video, design and animation in one flat fee, and that most B2B explainers cost $5,000 to $12,000 per minute. It also says one project can be cut into hooks, ad variations and social posts. Turnaround is not published. The[Vidico homepage](https://vidico.com/) lists offices in Melbourne, Sydney, New York, Dubai and Singapore.


**Best for** a B2B or SaaS team that wants explainer-grade animation and ad cutdowns from one vendor. **Look elsewhere if** you want a partner that plans around Facebook and Instagram placements, since the animation page does not mention them.


### Yum Yum Videos


As of October 2026,[Yum Yum Videos](https://www.yumyumvideos.com/) makes custom animated explainer videos in 2D, motion graphics, whiteboard and mixed media styles. Its FAQ says production can include strategy, scriptwriting, storyboard, custom illustration, animation, voiceover and sound design, that most projects take 7 to 9 weeks, and that rush production is available. Pricing is not published; the site offers a cost calculator and a call instead. It lists a headquarters in Miami and a production hub in Buenos Aires.


**Best for** one explainer that will live on your site and also run as an ad. Its site does not mention Facebook or Instagram ads, so ask for 9:16 and 4:5 cutdowns in the quote.


## Which studios fit crafted brand animation?


### Giant Ant


As of October 2026,[Giant Ant](https://www.giantant.ca/) is a creative studio in Vancouver whose homepage lists art, design, animation and ideas, with brand campaigns and brand spots among its featured projects. Its[about page](https://www.giantant.ca/about) calls it a creative studio, a design shop and an animation house. Pricing and turnaround are not published.


**Best for** a distinctive animated brand spot where art direction matters more than volume. The site does not discuss Facebook or Instagram, so ask how vertical cuts for Reels and Stories are handled.


### BUCK


As of October 2026,[BUCK](https://buck.co/about) describes itself as a talent-driven, global creative company working since 2004, with offices in Los Angeles, New York, Sydney, Amsterdam and London. Its[work page](https://buck.co/work) filters projects by 2D, 3D, character and live action and includes animated spots for brands. Pricing and turnaround are not published.


**Best for** a large campaign where one partner handles 2D, 3D, character work and live action. **Look elsewhere if** you need ads in weekly batches for testing; its site presents campaign and brand projects rather than ad batches.


## What makes an animated ad work in Facebook and Instagram placements?


An animated ad still has to fit where it runs. Meta's[Reels ads page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/facebook-instagram-reels-ads) (checked October 26, 2026) refers to the 9:16 vertical shape of Reels, says Reels default to sound on, and says Reels ads with key messages in the safe zone, quality audio and vertical video see better results. For Facebook Feed, Meta's[video ad guide](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide/video) recommends a 4:5 ratio at 1440 x 1800 pixels, accepts MP4, MOV or GIF files, and lists captions and sound as optional but recommended.


Not every animated ad needs a studio. Meta's Creative Shop guidance on[turning still image ads into video ads](https://www.facebook.com/business/news/4-ways-to-turn-still-image-ads-into-video-ads) , published in 2018, suggests adding one or two elements of motion over a few seconds, bringing the brand or the key benefit to life in a few seconds, or using motion to demonstrate how the product works. Meta's[Advantage+ creative page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/meta-advantage-plus/creative) mentions an image animation enhancement, and says some enhancements may be on by default and can be turned off at any time. If an agency delivers finished animation, preview the ad and turn off any enhancement that alters it.


An agency earns its fee when the idea needs an original character, a story or a product scene that simple motion cannot carry. Our[3D animated video ads guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/3d-animated-video-ads) covers briefing and reviewing character work, and our comparison of[animated ads vs UGC ads](https://knowlify.com/articles/animated-ads-vs-ugc-ads) helps decide whether to test animation at all.


## How much does an animated ad agency cost?


Of the seven other agencies above, three publish a price, as of October 2026, and each prices a different unit:


- **Per project.** B2W's animated commercials start from $2,400 for a 60-second video.
- **Per month.** Vidico's plans start around $5,000 a month. Superside's subscriptions start at a $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term, which is $180,000 over the first year (our arithmetic from its published minimum), and each subscription includes a $1,000 monthly software fee.
- **Not published.** Biddyco, Yum Yum Videos, Giant Ant and BUCK do not publish prices. Knowlify quotes on a call.


Media spend is always separate. To compare quotes, ask each agency for the same unit: finished ads in the sizes you need (9:16 and 4:5), split into new concepts and variations, with revision rounds and usage rights stated. A 60-second commercial cut into three lengths is one concept, not three.


## What should you ask an animated ad agency before you sign?


- **Formats.** Will every ad come in 9:16 and 4:5, with captions and key text inside the Reels safe zone?
- **Volume.** How many new concepts arrive each month, and how many are cutdowns or hook variations?
- **Revisions.** How many rounds, at which stages, and what counts as a new ad?
- **Ownership.** Do you keep the finished files and any source files, and can you edit them later?
- **AI use.** Which steps use AI, and who checks the output before delivery?
- **Media.** Who uploads and runs the ads, and who brings results back into the next brief?


Send every agency the same written brief so the answers are comparable; our[video ad campaign brief template](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-ad-campaign-brief) is a starting point.


## Key takeaways


- Our top pick is Knowlify for weekly AI-made 3D character, AI UGC and AI commercial ads, with optional Meta campaign management.
- Pick an animated ad agency by job: motion ads for Meta testing, a single commercial or explainer, or a crafted brand spot.
- As of October 2026, only B2W, Vidico and Superside publish prices in this group, and each prices a different unit.
- Ask for 9:16 and 4:5 versions with captions and safe-zone text, whichever agency you choose.
- Agree who runs the ads before the first batch arrives; none of the seven other agencies here says on its site that it manages campaigns.


## FAQ


### What is an animated ad agency?


It writes, designs and animates video ads with 2D, 3D, character animation or motion graphics instead of filmed footage. Some deliver one commercial per project and others a monthly flow of ads. Knowlify can also run the Facebook and Instagram campaigns; the other agencies in this guide do not say on their sites that they do.


### How much does an animated video ad cost?


Published prices in this comparison (checked October 26, 2026) start at $2,400 for a 60-second animated commercial at B2W, around $5,000 a month for Vidico's plans, and a $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term at Superside. The other agencies do not publish prices. Media spend is extra.


### Can I make animated ads inside Meta Ads Manager instead?


For light motion, often yes: Meta's guidance suggests a few seconds of motion on a still image, and its Advantage+ creative page mentions an image animation enhancement. An agency makes more sense for an original character, a story or a detailed product scene.


### Is Knowlify an animated ad agency?


Yes, and it is our top pick for weekly ads. Knowlify makes 3D character animation ads alongside AI UGC and AI commercials for Facebook and Instagram, and can manage the Meta campaigns that run them. If you need hand-drawn 2D, a broadcast commercial or a long website explainer, the studios in this guide are a better fit.
